text.en:
2386
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
WHEREAS, vast tracts of agricultural lands of the public
domain remain uncultivated, while on the other hand there
is urgent need of intensifying the production of foods
and other necessities of life;
WHEREAS, it is the duty of the government to extend
relief and assistance to all citizens through the acceleration
of the production of foods and other prime commodities,
the price of which up to the present is still beyond the
reach of the masses;
WHEREAS, it is the concern of the government to relieve
unemployment by mobilizing idle manpower for food dis-
duction; and
WHEREAS, there are a great number of citizers who are
desirous to engage in the production of foodstuffs and
other prime commodities;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby authorize the Chairman of the President's Action
Committee on Social Amelioration (PACSA), in consul-
tation with the Director of Lands, to allot unoccupied
agricultural lands of the public domain not otherwise re-
served for public or other purposes, to all interested
citizens. The area to be allotted to each interested citizen
shall not exceed 10 hectares according to his ability to
cultivate the same.
Each grantee shall cultivate his allotted area by planting
it to food crops and other prime commodities and the
produce harvested therein shall belong exclusively to him.
• Any grantee hereunder who fails to cultivate ½ of the
area allotted to him for a period of one 'agricultural year,
unless such failure is due to force maieure or other cir-
cumstances beyond his control, shall forfeit his right
Each grantee shall have the option to file a homestead
or sales application for the land allotted to him in accord-
ance with the provisions of Commonwealth Act No. 141,
as amended, and the rules and regulations promulgated
thereunder. The corresponding patent shall be issued only
upon proof that the applicant has cultivated ⅙ of the area
allotted to him and that he has complied with all of the
other requirements of said law prior to the issuance of
In the case of sale, the grantee shall be given 10 years
within which to pay the purchase price of the land in
accordance with the provisions of Commonwealth Act No.
141, as amended, and the rules and regulations promul-
gated thereunder.
Entry upon an allotted area of a land belonging to the
public domain pursuant to this order shall be subject to
cancellation and reversion to the State upon the same
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
grounds provided for in Commonwealth Act No. 141, as
The chairman of the President's Action Committee on
Social Amelioration shall issue, with the cooperation of
the Director of Lands ond approval of the Secretary of
Agriculture and Natural Resources, the necessary rules
and regulations to carry into effect the provisions of this
In order to effectively carry out the purpose of this
order and to hasten the subdivision survey of agricultival
lands of the public domain being undertaken by the Bureau
of Lands, the sum of P200,000 is hereby transferred from
the funds of the PACSA to the Bureau of Lands and
said amount will be disbursed, with the approval of the
Secretary uf Agriculture and Natural Resources.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
